files.README.md:
# Platform service configuration

Every service in this workspace keeps its live settings under config/, named
after the service. templates/ holds the canonical key set maintained by the
platform team: it lists every key a service settings file has to declare
before the service can be onboarded. Settings files are flat YAML and hold no
nested sections.
files.templates/service-keys.yaml:
# Canonical key set for platform services. Per-service values live in config/.
required_keys:
  - service_name
  - listen_port
  - retry_backoff_ms
  - max_inflight_batches
  - graceful_shutdown_seconds
  - ledger_endpoint
  - telemetry_sample_rate
files.config/payment-settler.yaml:
service_name: payment-settler
listen_port: 8120
max_inflight_batches: 24
graceful_shutdown_seconds: 45
ledger_endpoint: http://ledger.internal:9300
telemetry_sample_rate: 0.25
